New "GSTR-9 Workpaper" tab: upload a period's GSTR-1 JSON, GSTR-2B JSON, or GSTR-3B PDF — each upload supersedes (never silently overwrites) any previous file for that same period. Table 4 (outward supplies) compiled automatically from GSTR-1, month-wise GSTR-1 vs GSTR-3B reconciliation with exceptions flagged, Table 8 (ITC reconciliation) via automatic GSTR-2B-vs-Purchase-Register invoice matching, Table 9 (tax payable vs paid), Section 50 interest calculation, and a DRC-03 voluntary-advisory checker.

The DRC-03 checker is advisory only — it never files anything or initiates any payment on its own. Export a complete branded Excel workpaper covering all of the above with one click.

148 automated tests covering this module, plus the full existing 68/68 backend suite — all passing.
